name: District
description: District is a live events and online ticketing platform operated as a brand vertical by parent entity Eternal Ltd (formerly Zomato Limited).

stock.note: Reflects parent entity Eternal Ltd (ETERNAL.NS); District is a brand segment and does not have a separate listing.

marketing_spend.derivation: Modeled using consumer ticketing industry benchmarks, estimating annual ad and promotion spend at ₹50 Cr to ₹100 Cr to build brand equity and compete in the live events market under parent Eternal Ltd.

business_updates.headline: Eternal Ltd expands beyond restaurant delivery through its dedicated live events and online ticketing platform District.
Eternal Ltd continues operational investments in its 'Going out' and ticketing business segment.
